 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Rajive Ranjan Singh
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Bhanu Pratap Singh
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Anjani Kumar Sharan
 Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 1952/2019,
registered for the offence punishable under Sections 306, 420, 467, 468, 504 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code pending in the learned court below.
After some arguments, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw this application.
Accordingly, the instant application is dismissed as withdrawn.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.49692 of 2022(5) dt.23-03-2023

However, if the petitioner surrenders before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today and seeks regular bail, the learned Court below would pass the order, preferably, on the same day, without being Md.
